build_VoteNet_model: build a VoteNet model for 3D object detection in point clouds with hough voting
run_VoteNet_forward: run a forward pass of VoteNet on a point cloud tensor input
create_VoteNet_instance: create a VoteNet instance with configurable num_class, num_heading_bin, and num_proposal parameters
test_VoteNet_inference: test VoteNet inference on random or dataset point cloud samples
review_VoteNet_architecture: review the VoteNet architecture with backbone, voting module, and proposal module components
